headword: {院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}

definitions.explanation: The system in which a hospital issues a prescription and the patient has it filled at an independent pharmacy outside the facility. This is now the standard practice in Japan under the separation of prescribing and dispensing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}です。
{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: With out-of-hospital dispensing, you take the prescription to a pharmacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}→医薬分業：29888_iyakubungyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧になった。
examples.english: As the separation of prescribing and dispensing advanced, out-of-hospital dispensing became the norm.

notes:
The patient receives a prescription at the hospital and fills it at a separate ⟦{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}→調剤薬局：29876_chouzaiyakkyoku⟧ (dispensing pharmacy). Reflects ⟦{医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}→医薬分業：29888_iyakubungyou⟧, the policy of separating prescribing from dispensing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {院外|いんがい}⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧: an outpatient prescription slip
- {院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to out-of-hospital dispensing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}→院内処方：29877_innaishohou⟧: in-hospital dispensing — medicine is given out at the facility itself
